data.name: Anasa
data.gender_notes: Anasa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-n', meaning 'to give' or 'to provide'. In Islamic history, Anas ibn Malik was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his generosity and hospitality. The name Anasa carries the meaning “Giver, Provider” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anasa usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, provider and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the act of giving and providing, reflecting the qualities of kindness, generosity, and selflessness.
data.etymology: Anasa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Provider.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anasa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Anasa is a lovely and unique Arabic name with rich cultural roots. It is a name that evokes the essence of generosity and selflessness, reminding us of the noble qualities and noble deeds inspired by the life and teachings of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his devoted companion Anas ibn Malik. From the name comes the hope that the one bearing it will embody the spirit of giving and hospitality.
data.spiritual_significance: Anasa is a beautiful and evocative name with a profound spiritual meaning. Rooted in the concept of 'n-s-n', to give or provide, it reflects the desire to uphold the Islamic values of kindness, generosity, and compassion towards self and others. Anasa embodies the spirit of altruism and selflessness, inviting the one who bears the name to strive towards living a life that is guided by the mercy and compassion of Allah (SWT). It is a name that holds the potential to inspire a life of service, kindness, and continuous giving to oneself and to others, thereby fostering a connection with the divine and contributing to the betterment of society.
